def mk_area(g,noise):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    def ok(ii,jj,c): return g[ii][jj]==c or (ii,jj) in noise
    def area(i,j,c):
        best=0
        for r1 in range(i+1):
            for r2 in range(i,h):
                if not all(ok(ii,j,c) for ii in range(r1,r2+1)): continue
                lf=0
                while j-lf-1>=0 and all(ok(ii,j-lf-1,c) for ii in range(r1,r2+1)): lf+=1
                rt=0
                while j+rt+1<w and all(ok(ii,j+rt+1,c) for ii in range(r1,r2+1)): rt+=1
                best=max(best,(lf+rt+1)*(r2-r1+1))
        return best
    return area

def ruleA(g,bg):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if any(0<=i+di<h and 0<=j+dj<w and g[i+di][j+dj]==g[i][j] for di,dj in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1))): continue
            o=Counter(g[i+di][j+dj] for di,dj in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)) if 0<=i+di<h and 0<=j+dj<w)
            non={c:n for c,n in o.items() if c!=bg}
            if non and max(non.values())>=2:
                mx=max(non.values()); cs=[c for c,n in non.items() if n==mx]
                if len(cs)==1: out[i][j]=cs[0]
    return out
